name: Mask Line Reveal
description: Three headline lines slide up from behind their own masks with a slight hinge settle; an underline draws on; lines exit up through the same masks.
move: Three headline lines slide up from behind their own masks with a slight hinge settle; an underline draws on; lines exit up through the same masks.
how: Each authored line sits in an overflow:hidden block padded for descenders. Lines go yPercent 115→0 and rotation 4→0 about the bottom-left corner over 1.15s, stagger 0.12, ease cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). A rule scales X 0→1 with cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1). Exit: yPercent -115 with power3.in; the rule retracts to the right.
adapt: Author line breaks explicitly in the HTML (one .m > .line per line). The accent word is an <em>. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Slide Up by line with track matte" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
